t.en: Red Sea return accelerates: Gemini moves four more services back through Suez (six in total), first COSCO transit since the crisis began

t.zh: 巴拿马运河日通行量砍到 32 艘、拍卖位拍出 530 万美元天价：El Niño 之下东岸物流成本正在重写
t.en: Panama Canal cuts daily transits to 32 and an auction slot fetches a record $5.3m: El Niño is rewriting East Coast logistics costs

t.zh: 德国六港无限期罢工进入全员投票：64.7% 否决资方方案，10 月 1 日见分晓
t.en: Germany’s six seaports move to an all-member ballot on indefinite strikes: 64.7% rejected the employer offer, verdict due Oct 1

t.zh: 亚洲区内运价指数五连创新高至 1491 美元/FEU：台风、黄金周与油价把区内航线推上历史高位
t.en: Intra-Asia index hits a fifth straight record at $1,491/FEU: typhoons, Golden Week and bunker costs push regional lanes to historic highs

t.zh: 集装箱船订单簿冲破 45%：马士基 26 艘 ULCV + 达飞 12 艘 24,000TEU，创 2008 年末以来新高
t.en: Containership orderbook surges past 45%: Maersk’s 26 ULCVs and CMA CGM’s 12 × 24,000 TEU take the ratio to a post-2008 high

t.zh: DHL《物流趋势雷达 8.0》：Agentic AI 被列为最高影响趋势，AI 商务、算力经济与人形机器人新增入选
t.en: DHL Logistics Trend Radar 8.0: Agentic AI rated a top-impact trend, with AI Commerce, Compute Economy and Humanoids newly added

t.zh: Gartner 勾勒仓储 AI 四层演进：传统优化 → 运营式生成式 AI → 半自主代理 → 物理 AI 机器人
t.en: Gartner maps four waves of warehouse AI: traditional optimisation → operational GenAI → semi-autonomous agents → physical AI robots

t.zh: McKinsey：95% 货主已用至少一个运输 AI 用例，真正创造价值的公司有三个共同行为
t.en: McKinsey: 95% of shippers run at least one transportation AI use case — and value creators share three behaviours

t.zh: 亚马逊投 1 亿美元在印第安纳建机器人工厂：生产基地翻倍至四座，全球部署超 100 万台
t.en: Amazon commits $100m+ for a new robot plant in Indiana: production sites double to four, 1m+ robots already deployed

t.zh: Brittany Ferries 数字孪生航线优化省油 6%：数千航次验证 97% 可靠性，已推广到 9 艘船
t.en: Brittany Ferries saves up to 6% fuel with digital-twin routing: 97% reliability validated over thousands of voyages, now on 9 ships

t.zh: Maersk 接管 PUMA 美国分销网络：北美首个多客户 AutoStore 仓，年处理约 2000 万件并向其他品牌开放
t.en: Maersk takes over PUMA’s US distribution: North America’s first multi-client AutoStore site, ~20m units a year, open to other brands from 2027

t.zh: G7 同意释放 1 亿桶柴油与原油储备：四年内分批投放，前 20 天前置释放柴油
t.en: G7 agrees to release 100 million barrels of diesel and crude: staged over four months, front-loaded on diesel

t.zh: 中美互开 300 亿美元对等降税清单：美方 77 类、中方 1,619 项，休战延至 2027 年 1 月 10 日
t.en: China and the US publish mirror $30bn tariff-cut lists: 77 US lines, 1,619 Chinese lines, truce extended to Jan 10, 2027

t.zh: 苏伊士回摆进入“主力航线级”：COSCO 时隔两年多首次西行，Premier Alliance FE1 亦改为经运河
t.en: Suez return reaches mainline scale: COSCO’s first westbound transit in over two years, Premier Alliance FE1 rerouted

t.zh: 运价东西分化：SCFI 连二跌至 3662.30 点，欧地线续跌、美线逆势小涨，承运人押注 10 月中 FAK 上调
t.en: East–West split deepens: SCFI falls a second week to 3662.30, Europe/Med down again, US lanes up, carriers push mid-October FAKs

t.zh: 霍尔木兹风险常态化：9 月 29 日再有商船被不明投射物击中起火，UKMTO 建议谨慎通行
t.en: Hormuz risk normalises: another merchant vessel hit by an unidentified projectile on Sept 29, UKMTO advises caution

t.zh: 德国港口劳资进入关键窗口：无限期罢工投票 10 月 1 日截止需 75% 反对率，北欧堆场 88–90% 已无缓冲
t.en: German port labour at a decision point: indefinite-strike ballot closed Oct 1 on a 75% rejection threshold, North European yards at 88–90%

t.zh: 马尼拉港“数字休息日”：报关行与卡车司机以停点鼠标方式抗议空箱无处可还，行业内部出现分裂
t.en: Manila’s digital “rest day”: brokers and truckers protest by logging off as empty boxes pile up, with the industry split

t.zh: 欧盟钢铁新规 10 月 1 日起强制“熔炼地”证明：配额砍 47%、配额外税率翻倍至 50% 且可叠加
t.en: EU steel regime tightens Oct 1: melt-and-pour proof becomes mandatory, quotas cut 47%, out-of-quota duty doubled to 50% and stackable

t.zh: 运力悖论量化：订单簿超 1,400 万 TEU（约现有船队 42%），2026 船队仅增 4.6%、2027 增 9%
t.en: The capacity paradox, quantified: orderbook above 14m TEU (~42% of fleet), fleet growth just 4.6% in 2026 and 9% in 2027

t.zh: 航空枢纽评价本周双榜：新华社系“创新指数”与 OAG Megahubs 2026 给出两套完全不同的排名逻辑
t.en: Two air-hub scorecards this week: a Xinhua innovation index and OAG Megahubs 2026 rank hubs on opposite logics

t.zh: DHL《全球联结度报告 2026》：2025 年全球化仍处历史高位，货物平均运距 5,010 公里创纪录
t.en: DHL Global Connectedness Report 2026: globalisation held near record highs in 2025, with goods travelling a record 5,010 km on average

t.zh: Barrett Distribution 与 UNIT AI 扩合作：2027 起用“网络化物理 AI”打通全国仓网的库存、履约与退货
t.en: Barrett Distribution expands UNIT AI partnership: networked physical AI across its national warehouse network from 2027

t.zh: 真仓跑出真实曲线：科捷物流天津武清仓机器人拣选占比 5 个月内由不足 1% 升至近 17%
t.en: A real warehouse, a real curve: Kejie’s Tianjin Wuqing site lifts robot picking share from under 1% to nearly 17% in five months

t.zh: 中国快递业务量破 1,500 亿件：比 2025 年提前 12 天，自动化分拣与无人配送进入规模放量
t.en: China’s parcel volume passes 150 billion: 12 days earlier than 2025, with automated sorting and unmanned delivery scaling

t.zh: 德国港口无限期罢工风险解除：ver.di 接受 3.4% 涨薪方案，覆盖六港约 11,000 人，但拥堵与莱茵河枯水未解
t.en: German port strike risk recedes: ver.di accepts a 3.4% pay deal covering about 11,000 workers at six ports — congestion and low Rhine water remain

t.zh: 苏伊士回摆扩至联盟级：Premier Alliance 两条亚欧线改道，马士基与赫伯罗特再挪四条线，Drewry 称每箱位仅省 43 美元
t.en: Suez return goes alliance-wide: Premier Alliance reroutes two Asia–Europe loops, Maersk and Hapag-Lloyd shift four more — Drewry puts the saving at just $43 per slot

t.zh: 霍尔木兹袭击创冲突以来单周新高：9/28—10/5 至少 12 起油轮与气体船遇袭，VLCC TD3C 日租金冲上约 140 万美元
t.en: Hormuz attacks hit a conflict-high week: at least 12 tanker and gas-carrier incidents Sept 28–Oct 5, with VLCC TD3C earnings near $1.4m a day

t.zh: 运价分化加剧：SCFI 微涨 0.05% 结束两周连跌、欧地终结 13 周跌势，Drewry WCI 却续跌 2% 至 4,351 美元
t.en: Rates diverge: SCFI inches up 0.05% to end a two-week slide and Europe/Med snap a 13-week losing run, while Drewry’s WCI falls another 2% to $4,351

t.zh: 班轮准班率跌至 49.9%：Sea-Intelligence 称创 2022 年 9 月以来最低，亚洲区域仅 32.3%、中国 23.9%
t.en: Liner schedule reliability falls to 49.9% — Sea-Intelligence’s lowest since Sept 2022, with Asia at 32.3% and China at 23.9%

t.zh: CBP 拟重构 2,500 美元以下进口规则：申报提前到“到港日或之前”、新增第 13 类邮件报关、全面加担保
t.en: CBP proposes to rebuild the sub-$2,500 import regime: filing pulled forward to arrival, a new mail entry type 13, and bonds across the board

t.zh: FCC 26-50 于 10 月 13 日生效：设备授权由“整机审核”穿透到芯片，Covered List 实体的逻辑承载组件一律拒批
t.en: FCC 26-50 takes effect Oct 13: equipment authorisation drills from the finished device down to the chip, denying any logic-bearing part from a Covered List entity

t.zh: 英国拟对华电动车加征最高 45% 关税：现税率 10%，方案尚未批准，欧盟“欧洲制造”规则是主要推手
t.en: UK weighs tariffs of up to 45% on Chinese EVs against a 10% baseline — not approved, with the EU’s “Made in Europe” rule the main driver

t.zh: Drewry 复盘“苏伊士悖论”：每箱位只省 43 美元，回摆靠航程而非成本；基准情形 2027 年 2 月恢复到八成
t.en: Drewry unpacks the Suez paradox: only $43 saved per slot, transit time not cost drives the return, with 80% recovery by Feb 2027

t.zh: Gartner：63% 采购高管预期 AI 显著提效，但仅 25% 做过岗位重设计——“岗位混乱”风险被点名
t.en: Gartner: 63% of procurement leaders expect AI to lift performance, but only 25% have redesigned roles — “job chaos” flagged

t.zh: WorldACD：9 月全球空运吨量同比 +9%、运价同比 +25%，但运力同比仅 +4%、海湾方向较冲突前仍低 17%
t.en: WorldACD: September air cargo tonnages +9% YoY and rates +25%, yet capacity is only +4% and Gulf capacity stays 17% below pre-conflict

t.zh: 时尚退货进真仓：Sereact 双臂机器人在德国 Greven 与波兰 Świebodzin 上线，Cortex 主打“没见过的商品”
t.en: Fashion returns go live: Sereact’s dual-arm robots start at Greven and Świebodzin, with Cortex built for items it has never seen

t.zh: 中国铁路 10 月 10 日启用新货物列车运行图：城际班列 151 列、多式联运 237 列、大宗直达 423 列，中欧班列图定线路 96 条
t.en: China’s railways switch to a new freight timetable on Oct 10: 151 intercity, 237 intermodal and 423 bulk direct trains, with 96 China–Europe scheduled lines

t.zh: 中国自动化码头 60 座：自动化集装箱码头 30 座占全球 27%，单机效率超 60 自然箱/小时，国际集装箱船平均在港 1.7 天
t.en: China has 60 automated terminals: 30 automated container berths, 27% of the global total, with crane rates above 60 boxes/hour and 1.7-day average port time

t.zh: Drewry WCI 反弹 3% 至 4,485 美元：亚欧终结 13 周连跌，但承运人 10 月 19 日 FAK 上调落地仍存疑
t.en: Drewry’s WCI rebounds 3% to $4,485: Asia–Europe ends a 13-week slide, though carriers’ Oct 19 FAK push remains uncertain

t.zh: 苏伊士通行首破中断前 50%：10 月前两周周均 75.3 万 TEU，走运河比例由 8% 跳升至 36%
t.en: Suez transits pass half of pre-disruption levels for the first time: 753,000 TEU a week in early October, canal share jumping from 8% to 36%

t.zh: 全船型收益五连创历史新高：ClarkSea 指数涨 12% 至 84,951 美元/天，VLCC 日均突破 80 万美元
t.en: Shipping earnings set a fifth straight record: the ClarkSea Index climbs 12% to $84,951 a day with VLCCs above $800,000

t.zh: 2026 北外滩国际航运论坛 10 月 20 日开幕：60 余场活动、成果总数超 60 项，水运“十五五”规划与 22 个人工智能场景同步落地
t.en: 2026 North Bund International Shipping Forum opens Oct 20: more than 60 events and 60-plus deliverables, alongside the 15th Five-Year Plan for water transport and 22 AI use cases

t.zh: 巴拿马运河放宽限制：新巴拿马型吃水回到 49 英尺，10 月 15 日起日通行升至 33 个，但流域仍处缺水状态
t.en: Panama Canal eases restrictions: Neopanamax draft back to 49 feet and 33 daily transits from Oct 15, though the watershed remains in deficit

t.zh: 美国考虑给“影子船队”开闸：被制裁油轮可承运“合法石油”，须 OFAC 逐案批准，业界普遍判断压价效果有限
t.en: Washington weighs a shadow-fleet release: sanctioned tankers could carry “legal oil” with case-by-case OFAC approval — but the industry sees limited rate relief

t.zh: 高盛测算运费已重构原油价差：全球原油平均运输费升至 30 美元/桶（一年前 4 美元），中东航线 35 美元
t.en: Goldman Sachs: freight has re-priced crude spreads — average global crude transport cost at $30 a barrel against $4 a year ago, $35 on Middle East routes

t.zh: IMO 净零框架进入 12 天三会决战：11/23—12/4 决定通过、改稿还是再延，最早也要 2028 年 4 月才生效
t.en: The IMO Net-Zero Framework enters a 12-day, three-session endgame: Nov 23–Dec 4 decides adoption, rewrite or another deferral, with entry into force no earlier than April 2028

t.zh: 回摆到底释放多少运力：BIMCO 测算改道曾推高全球需求约 10%，Linerlytica 与德路里给出 2027 年时点
t.en: How much capacity does the Suez return release? BIMCO puts the diversion premium at about 10% of global demand, with Linerlytica and Drewry timing full recovery to 2027

t.zh: 空运旺季尚未兑现：WorldACD 第 41 周吨量同比 +9%、运价同比 +29%，运力同比仅 +1%，海湾方向较 2 月底仍低 20%
t.en: No Q4 air-cargo peak yet: WorldACD week 41 shows tonnages +9% and rates +29% year on year, capacity only +1%, with Gulf capacity still 20% below late February

t.zh: 干散货与油轮彻底分道：BDI 连跌七个交易日至 2,801 点，较 9 月 4 日峰值低约 23%，好望角型日收益跌破 3.3 万美元
t.en: Dry bulk and tankers part company: the BDI falls for a seventh session to 2,801, about 23% below its Sept 4 peak, with capesize earnings under $33,000 a day

t.zh: 极智嘉 1,600 余台机器人落地 LPP 波兰两座履约中心：140 万个高位存储货位，实测运营效率 99%
t.en: Geekplus puts more than 1,600 robots into two LPP fulfilment centres in Poland: 1.4m high-bay storage locations and measured operating efficiency of 99%

t.zh: 仓库里的代理权限有了刻度：Logistics Reply 发布 LEA AI Agent Authority Model，四档成熟度 × 五档权限
t.en: Agent authority in the warehouse gets a scale: Logistics Reply launches the LEA AI Agent Authority Model — four maturity stages by five authority levels

t.zh: FourKites 改卖“结果”：承诺十年内让 AI 代理替客户完成 10 亿小时运营工作，网络图覆盖 176 国
t.en: FourKites switches to selling outcomes: a commitment that its AI agents will complete one billion hours of operational work for customers over a decade, on a network spanning 176 countries

t.zh: Drewry WCI 连涨两周至 4,585 美元、创 15 周新高：亚欧停航由 2 班跳至 8 班，上海港等泊时间从 97 小时降到 38 小时
t.en: Drewry’s WCI rises a second week to $4,585, a 15-week high: Asia–Europe blankings jump from two to eight as Shanghai waiting time falls from 97 to 38 hours

t.zh: 巴拿马运河 2026 财年货运量创历史新高 5.21 亿吨：霍尔木兹受阻改写航线，但干旱把日通行压回 32 艘
t.en: Panama Canal posts a record 521m tons in FY2026 as the Hormuz closure reroutes trade, though drought pulls daily transits back to 32

t.zh: 黑海商船连遭袭击，北约增派巡逻机、雷达与无人机：10 月至少 7 起、约 30 名船员死亡或失踪
t.en: NATO sends extra patrol aircraft, radar and drones to the Black Sea after a run of merchant-ship attacks: at least seven in October, about 30 seafarers dead or missing

t.zh: 10 月 30 日欧洲与地中海 50 多个港口联合行动：意大利 8 港在列，涉事港口约占地中海集装箱吞吐量 40%
t.en: More than 50 European and Mediterranean ports to act jointly on 30 October: eight Italian ports listed, together handling around 40% of Mediterranean container throughput

t.zh: Alphaliner：远东—欧洲运力已有 63% 回到红海—苏伊士，但多数航线只“单程走运河”
t.en: Alphaliner: 63% of Far East–Europe capacity is back on Red Sea–Suez routings, though most loops transit the canal in one direction only

t.zh: 莱茵河低水位把驳船货挤向铁路与公路：杜伊斯堡载重仅约三分之二，15%—30% 货量找不到替代运力
t.en: Low Rhine water pushes barge cargo onto rail and road: Duisburg loads at about two-thirds, with capacity short for 15%–30% of affected volumes

t.zh: 黄海南部连续 47 天实弹射击禁航：坐标落在连云港—盐城外海，个别物流自媒体“影响青岛港航道”的说法与坐标不符
t.en: Southern Yellow Sea closed for live-fire drills for 47 straight days: coordinates place the zone off Lianyungang–Yancheng, contradicting logistics blogs claiming Qingdao’s approaches are affected

t.zh: 欧盟 11 月 1 日起对直邮包裹按行加收 2 欧元处理费：7 月取消低值豁免后，中欧空运吨量仍未回到去年同期
t.en: EU’s €2 per-line parcel handling fee takes effect 1 November, with China–Europe air volumes still below last year after July’s de minimis removal

t.zh: 干散货与油轮同步回落，海岬型逆势反弹：BDI 收 2,660、好望角型 5TC 回到 34,380 美元/天，VLCC 日收益跌至 128.8 万美元
t.en: Dry bulk and tankers ease together while capesizes rebound: BDI closes at 2,660, capesize 5TC back to $34,380/day, VLCC daily earnings down to $1.288m

t.zh: 空运旺季尚未兑现：WorldACD 第 41 周吨量环比连降三周、同比仍 +9%，波罗的海空运指数同比 +26.4% 且高于前两个旺季峰值
t.en: Air peak yet to land: WorldACD week 41 tonnage falls a third straight week though still +9% y/y, while the Baltic Air Freight Index is +26.4% y/y and above the last two peak seasons

t.zh: Gartner 首个 PIM 魔力象限：产品数据成为 AI 代理的燃料，16 家厂商 5 家入领导者，MCP 服务器正成为新接口
t.en: Gartner’s first PIM Magic Quadrant: product data as fuel for AI agents, five Leaders among 16 vendors, with MCP servers becoming the new interface

t.zh: 退货机器人进入“闭环训练”：Sereact、NVIDIA、Nebius 与 CEVA、Zalando 把策略迭代周期从数周压到数天
t.en: Returns robots enter closed-loop training: Sereact, NVIDIA, Nebius, CEVA Logistics and Zalando compress policy cycles from weeks to days

t.zh: 物理 AI 走过试点期：Teradyne Robotics 与 Sereact 合作，欧洲已交付数百套双臂 UR 系统处理 Zalando 退货
t.en: Physical AI moves past pilot: Teradyne Robotics and Sereact have shipped hundreds of dual-arm UR systems across Europe for Zalando returns

t.zh: 德马科技与蚂蚁灵波合作，把具身基座模型拉上真实仓储流水线：首期攻坚海量包裹高速柔性分拣
t.en: Damon Technology and Ant Lingbo bring an embodied foundation model onto live warehouse lines, starting with high-speed flexible parcel sortation

t.zh: 霍尔木兹海峡现本轮冲突首次“吸附式”袭船：小船贴靠油轮安放两枚爆炸装置，机舱起火、船只一度失去动力
t.en: First “limpet-style” attack of the current conflict in the Strait of Hormuz: a small craft plants two explosive devices on a tanker, starting an engine-room fire

t.zh: Drewry WCI 回落 3% 至 4,429 美元、连涨两周终结：跨太平洋单周跌 6%，11 月 1 日涨价被判“实际已失败”
t.en: Drewry’s WCI falls 3% to $4,429, ending a two-week rally: transpacific down 6% in a week and the 1 November GRI called “effectively doomed”

t.zh: USTR 提议把对华船舶 301 港口费再冻结两个月：现行暂停 11 月 9 日到期，拟延至 2027 年 1 月 9 日
t.en: USTR proposes freezing Section 301 port fees on China-linked vessels for two more months: current pause expires 9 November, extension to 9 January 2027 proposed

t.zh: 美西双港 250 名守夜人握有罢工授权、最早 11 月 1 日停工：涉事码头承担长滩 85% 货量，铁路端已积压 35,688 箱
t.en: 250 watchmen at the US west coast port complex hold strike authorisation from 1 November: their terminals handle 85% of Long Beach cargo, with 35,688 boxes already awaiting rail

t.zh: 9 月全球班轮准班率 50.6%、仍处四年最差区间：上海仅 12.2%，亚洲拥堵把“双班航行”推过 2021 年疫情峰值
t.en: Global liner schedule reliability was 50.6% in September, still in its worst band in four years: Shanghai at 12.2% as Asian congestion pushes “double sailings” past the 2021 pandemic peak

t.zh: 苏伊士回摆有了硬数字：马士基过境 146→276 艘、净吨翻三倍，但亚欧现货仍比危机前高 67%，货主组织警告“一枚导弹就可能打回原点”
t.en: The Suez return gets hard numbers: Maersk transits rise from 146 to 276 and net tonnage triples, yet Asia–Europe spot rates remain 67% above pre-crisis, with shippers warned it is “one missile strike” from reversal

t.zh: 空运旺季呈现“价涨量跌”：现货周涨 5% 至 3.80 美元/公斤、同比 +38%，但全球吨量连降、亚太—欧盟货量同比 -16%
t.en: Air cargo peak shows price without volume: spot rates up 5% to $3.80/kg and 38% year on year, while global tonnage keeps falling and Asia Pacific–EU volumes are down 16%

t.zh: 中欧班列累计开行突破 14 万列、货值超 5,600 亿美元；河南首发“跨波罗的海”铁海联运新通道
t.en: China–Europe freight train services pass 140,000 trips and $560bn in cargo value, as Henan launches a first “trans-Baltic” rail-sea corridor

t.zh: Gartner 两份调查同月给出冷水：仅 13% 的 CIO 称企业从 AI 获得显著价值，仅 3% 真正实现降本
t.en: Two Gartner surveys pour cold water in the same month: only 13% of CIOs report significant enterprise value from AI, and only 3% have actually cut costs

t.zh: Gartner：到 2029 年，30% 因 AI 被裁的员工需要被重新雇回、且成本更高；供应链的裁员有 66% 集中在入门级
t.en: Gartner: by 2029, 30% of employees laid off because AI replaced them will need to be rehired, at higher cost — and 66% of supply chain cuts land at entry level

t.zh: “AI 采用高原”被三组独立研究同时证实：600 家上市公司仅 6% 领先，不到两成企业真的重设计了人机工作流
t.en: The “AI adoption plateau” is corroborated by three independent studies: only 6% of 600 listed firms are leaders and under a fifth have genuinely redesigned human-AI workflows

t.zh: GXO 把 Agility 的 Digit 人形机器人扩到第三、第四个仓：佐治亚站已搬运 10 万个周转箱，未披露台数、金额与吞吐目标
t.en: GXO extends Agility’s Digit humanoids to a third and fourth site: the Georgia site has moved 100,000 totes, though unit counts, contract value and throughput targets stay undisclosed

t.zh: CeMAT ASIA 2026（11 月 3—6 日，上海）预告：西门子、库卡、极智嘉同场把“人形机器人 + 编排软件 + 货到人”拉进真实仓内流程
t.en: CeMAT ASIA 2026 (3–6 November, Shanghai) preview: Siemens, KUKA and Geek+ put humanoids, orchestration software and goods-to-person into real warehouse flows

t.zh: 京东物流推出面向独立站商家的一体化跨境供应链方案：26 国 200 余仓、200 万平方米，拣货效率称提升 3 倍以上
t.en: JD Logistics launches an integrated cross-border supply chain solution for direct-to-consumer merchants: 200+ warehouses across 26 countries, 2m sqm, and claimed 3x picking efficiency

t.zh: 波斯湾油轮 MT Velos Sapphire 疑遭无人机袭击、一名菲律宾船员身亡：IMO 理事会闭幕谴责红海与曼德海峡袭船，UKMTO 年内已录 155 起美伊冲突相关事件
t.en: Tanker MT Velos Sapphire hit by suspected drone in the Persian Gulf, killing a Filipino seafarer: IMO Council condemns Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab attacks as UKMTO logs 155 US–Iran conflict-related incidents this year

t.zh: 中方同步再踩一脚“暂停 pedals”：11 月 10 日起两个月内继续暂停 24% 对美加征关税、保留 10%，美船特港费与调查暂停延至 2027 年 1 月 10 日
t.en: China extends its pauses in step: the 24% additional tariff on US imports stays suspended for two more months from 10 November (10% remains), and special port fees on US ships plus the shipping probe are paused until 10 January 2027

t.zh: 德路里 WCI 小跌 1% 至 4,389 美元、11 月宣涨全线证伪：马士基第 46 周开舱 3,000 美元连降两周、阳明低至 2,400 刷新最低 FAK，欧线集运期货单周挫 12.89%
t.en: Drewry WCI slips 1% to $4,389 and the November rate hikes are falsified across the board: Maersk’s week-46 opening offers fall to $3,000 for a second straight week, Yang Ming hits $2,400 as the lowest FAK, and the EU route futures shed 12.89% in a week

t.zh: 美西“守夜人”罢工威胁第三次延期：PMA 与 ILWU Local 26 把谈判期限延至 11 月 20 日，联邦调解继续、风险未解除
t.en: US west coast watchmen strike threat postponed a third time: PMA and ILWU Local 26 extend the bargaining deadline to 20 November with federal mediation continuing and the risk unresolved

t.zh: 苏伊士回摆再进一步：双子星 ME1 改道红海 11 月 4 日首航、长荣 2024 年 1 月来首次重返，上周 53 艘过境同比 +130%，Xeneta 称已释放 60 万 TEU、2027 年现货或跌约 30%
t.en: The Suez swing advances again: Gemini’s ME1 diverts through the Red Sea with a first sailing on 4 November, Evergreen returns for the first time since January 2024, 53 boxeships transited last week (+130% year on year), and Xeneta counts 600,000 teu of capacity already released with spot rates seen down about 30% in 2027

t.zh: 《华尔街日报》曝光胡塞“邮件审批”通行制：HOCC 通常 24 小时内回复、发放 7 天许可并要求全程开启 AIS——中国集装箱船“中成畅领”号通关邮件成为一手样本
t.en: The Wall Street Journal exposes the Houthis’ email-based transit clearance: the HOCC typically replies within 24 hours, issues 7-day permits and requires AIS kept on throughout — the clearance emails of Chinese boxship Zhong Cheng Chang Ling are the first-hand sample

t.zh: 第九届进博会集中签约观察：中国石化 413 亿美元、中国石油 38 份协议超 188 亿美元、中粮超百亿美元，技术装备类拟成交 155.2 亿美元同比 +17.6%
t.en: CIIE signing round-up: Sinopec at $41.3bn, CNPC with 38 agreements above $18.8bn, COFCO above $10bn, and intended deals in technical equipment at $15.52bn, up 17.6% year on year

t.zh: 麦肯锡 State of AI 2026（1,719 名受访者、97 国）：采用继续铺开而 EBIT 影响原地踏步——44% 规模化、仅 37% 见到任何盈利影响、高绩效者稳定在约 6%，32% 大型组织开始“自建替代采购”
t.en: McKinsey’s State of AI 2026 (1,719 respondents, 97 countries): adoption keeps spreading while EBIT impact stands still — 44% scaling, only 37% reporting any earnings impact, high performers steady at about 6%, and 32% of large organisations now build instead of buy

t.zh: NBER 工作论文 34836 把“AI 生产率悖论”再压一档：近 9,000 名高管将过去三年 0.2% 的年生产率增长归因于 AI，未来三年预期也仅 0.6%；另一波次 89% 称对劳动生产率毫无影响
t.en: NBER working paper 34836 presses the AI productivity paradox further: nearly 9,000 executives credit AI with 0.2% annual productivity growth over the past three years and expect only 0.6% ahead, while an earlier wave had 89% reporting no labour-productivity impact at all

t.zh: MHI 与德勤年度报告的供应链技术天平：AI 以 48%（+25 个百分点）居十年最大颠覆技术，机器人/自动化以 39%（+16）跃居第二——但另一项德勤调查显示仅 21% 的企业具备成熟的智能体治理
t.en: The MHI–Deloitte annual report’s supply chain technology scale: AI leads as the biggest disruptor of the decade at 48% (+25 points), robotics/automation jumps to second at 39% (+16) — yet a separate Deloitte survey finds only 21% with mature agentic-AI governance

t.zh: AutoStore 三季度营收 +38% 并上调全年指引至约 7.5 亿美元，同时以最高 3,000 万欧元收购荷兰托盘机器人厂商 Logiqs——立方仓储霸主补上“托盘层”
t.en: AutoStore posts Q3 revenue up 38% and raises full-year guidance to about $750m while agreeing to buy Dutch pallet-robot maker Logiqs for up to €30m — the cube-storage leader adds the pallet layer

t.zh: 人形机器人第一股：Agility Robotics 11 月 5 日以 AGLT 登陆纳斯达克，业务合并募资约 4.65 亿美元、Digit 5 承诺订单超 3 亿美元
t.en: The first pure-play humanoid listing: Agility Robotics begins trading on Nasdaq as AGLT on 5 November, raising about $465m gross from its business combination with Digit 5 committed orders above $300m

t.zh: CeMAT ASIA 2026 实况：950 余家参展商把“具身智能 + 集群调度”拉进真实仓——睿尔曼 W1 自拣选机器人 50 台集群、京东“保姆狼”首搭双臂、菜鸟攀爬机器人瞄准存量仓改造
t.en: CeMAT ASIA 2026 on the floor: 950+ exhibitors pull embodied AI and fleet orchestration into real warehouses — Rui Erman’s W1 self-picking robot runs 50-robot fleets, JD’s “Nanny Wolf” debuts dual arms, and Cainiao’s climbing robots target retrofitting existing warehouses

t.zh: 灵初智能具身整机入驻李宁华东智慧物流中心：入箱拣场景进入试运行、承接商业订单——鞋服仓“非结构化拣选”再添一个单源案例
t.en: Psi Bot’s embodied robot enters Li-Ning’s East China smart logistics centre: tote-in-box picking enters trial operation on commercial orders — one more single-source case for unstructured apparel-warehouse picking

signal.zh: 外部报道显示需求或货量出现连续方向性变化（如空运价涨量跌、旺季未兑现）
signal.en: External reporting shows a sustained directional shift in demand or volumes (e.g. air rates up while tonnage falls, peak season not materialising)

action.zh: 把近 8 周需求预测表与实绩表并列，逐 SKU-周核对「预测量 / 实绩量 / 偏差率」三列；由需求计划与销售各确认一次偏差归因，标注是趋势还是一次性事件
action.en: Place the last 8 weeks of forecast and actuals side by side; per SKU-week reconcile forecast / actual / variance. Demand planning and sales each sign off on the variance attribution and label it trend vs one-off

trigger.zh: 同一方向的外部信号在滚动 4 周内出现 ≥2 次，且预测偏差连续 2 期同号
trigger.en: Same-direction external signal appears at least twice in a rolling 4-week window, with forecast variance sharing the same sign for 2 consecutive periods

fields.zh: SKU、周次、预测版本、模型版本、预测量、人工调整量、实绩量、预测偏差率、归因码、主数据完整率、确认人、确认日期
fields.en: SKU, week, forecast version, model version, forecast qty, manual override, actual qty, forecast variance %, reason code, master-data completeness, approver, approval date

owner.zh: 供应链计划 / 风险管理

signal.zh: 关键航路、运河或枢纽同时出现两条以上相互叠加的中断信号
signal.en: Two or more overlapping disruption signals hit the same lane, canal or hub

action.zh: 打开情景预案台账，逐条核对「触发情景 / 受影响 SKU 清单 / 备选路线 / 预案最后复核日」；对超过复核周期的情景发起一次桌面推演并记录结论，不改动正式计划
action.en: Open the scenario register and reconcile trigger condition / affected SKU list / alternate lane / last review date. Run a tabletop review for scenarios past their review date and log the outcome; do not change the live plan

trigger.zh: 同一节点信号在滚动 4 周内 ≥2 次，或预案复核日超过设定周期
trigger.en: Two or more signals on the same node in a rolling 4-week window, or the scenario review date is past its cycle

fields.zh: 情景编号、节点、受影响 SKU、备选路线、复核周期、上次复核日、推演结论
fields.en: Scenario ID, node, affected SKUs, alternate lane, review cycle, last review date, exercise outcome

signal.zh: 报道出现新关税、加征、反制或税率调整（含尚在征求意见阶段的提案）
signal.en: New tariff, surcharge, retaliation or rate change reported, including proposals still under consultation

action.zh: 在《进口税则台账》中按 HS 编码 + 原产国检索受影响在采 SKU，逐行核对「现行税率 / 法规生效日 / 是否提案 / 官方文号」；由关务确认归类依据与在途单完税条款（Incoterms）及法规生效日，采购标记需重新询价的品项，提案未生效的单独标注
action.en: Query the import-duty register by HS code + country of origin for affected active SKUs; reconcile current rate / regulatory effective date / proposal status / official reference. Customs confirms the classification basis plus the in-transit duty terms (Incoterms) and regulatory effective date; sourcing flags items for re-quote. Keep unenacted proposals separately labelled

trigger.zh: 同一税则方向的信号在滚动 4 周内 ≥2 次，或出现明确法规生效日期
trigger.en: Two or more same-direction tariff signals in a rolling 4-week window, or a stated regulatory effective date

fields.zh: SKU、HS 编码、原产国、现行税率、法规生效日、提案/已生效、官方文号、归类依据、在途单完税条款(Incoterms)、确认人
fields.en: SKU, HS code, origin, current rate, regulatory effective date, proposal/enacted, official ref, classification basis, in-transit duty terms (Incoterms), approver

signal.zh: 报道出现出口管制、实体清单或组件级授权穿透（如设备授权从整机追到芯片）
signal.en: Export controls, entity lists, or component-level authorisation reach are reported

action.zh: 在《BOM-供应商合规台账》中按「料号 → 上级总成 → 供应商实体」反查，核对每一层的受控标记与授权文号；对无法追溯到底层的料号登记为待核，交合规比对官方最新清单
action.en: Traverse the BOM-to-supplier compliance register (component → assembly → legal entity) and check the controlled flag and authorisation reference at each level. Mark untraceable components as pending and have compliance compare against the latest official list

trigger.zh: 受控范围描述发生一次变更，或新增任一清单实体
trigger.en: One change in the described control scope, or any newly listed entity

fields.zh: 料号、上级总成、供应商法人实体、受控标记、授权文号、追溯状态、比对日期
fields.en: Component ID, parent assembly, supplier legal entity, controlled flag, authorisation ref, traceability status, check date

signal.zh: 报道出现申报规则、低值豁免或单证披露要求调整
signal.en: Changes to declaration rules, de minimis exemptions or document-disclosure requirements

action.zh: 取《近 90 天进口申报明细》，核对新要求涉及的字段是否已有采集来源；对缺字段的渠道列出「字段 / 责任方 / 补采方式」，并让报关行书面确认口径，不在系统内先填默认值
action.en: Pull the last 90 days of import declarations and check whether each newly required field already has a capture source. List field / owner / collection method for gaps and get written confirmation of interpretation from the broker — do not pre-fill defaults

trigger.zh: 出现明确截止日或征求意见期结束
trigger.en: A stated deadline or the close of a consultation period

fields.zh: 申报编号、渠道、新增字段、现有采集来源、责任方、补采方式、口径确认函
fields.en: Declaration ID, channel, new field, existing source, owner, collection method, written interpretation

signal.zh: 报道出现供应商破产、产线关停或订单转移
signal.en: Supplier insolvency, plant closure or order reallocation reported

action.zh: 在《合格供应商名录》中按法人实体精确匹配（不用品牌简称），核对「在供料号 / 份额 / 备源状态 / 最近一次财务与产能复核日」；对被点名料号发起一次产能与在手订单确认，结论只登记不断供判定
action.en: Match the legal entity exactly in the approved-vendor master (not the brand shorthand); reconcile active parts / share / alternate-source status / last financial & capacity review. Request a capacity and open-order confirmation for named parts; log findings without declaring a supply cut

trigger.zh: 同一实体被点名，或在供料号的备源状态为空
trigger.en: The same entity is named, or an active part has no alternate-source status

fields.zh: 供应商法人实体、在供料号、份额、备源、财务复核日、产能复核日、确认函编号
fields.en: Supplier legal entity, active parts, share, alternate source, financial review date, capacity review date, confirmation ref

signal.zh: 报道出现原产地、熔炼地或供应商准入证照的新举证要求
signal.en: New evidentiary requirements for origin, smelt location or supplier admission certificates

action.zh: 在《供应商证照台账》核对「证照类型 / 有效期 / 覆盖范围 / 出具机构」，逐料号确认新要求是否落在现有覆盖范围内；过期或覆盖不到的登记补证清单，交合规按官方最新文本复核适用范围与时效
action.en: Reconcile certificate type / validity / scope / issuing body in the supplier certificate register; per part confirm whether the new requirement falls inside existing coverage. Log expired or out-of-scope items for renewal, with compliance verifying scope and validity against the latest official text

trigger.zh: 新增举证要求一次，或抽检发现任一证照临近有效期
trigger.en: One new evidentiary requirement, or any certificate nearing expiry in sampling

fields.zh: 料号、证照类型、有效期、覆盖范围、出具机构、补证状态、复核人
fields.en: Part ID, certificate type, validity, scope, issuing body, renewal status, reviewer

signal.zh: 报道出现区域制造调整、订单转向或产线切换
signal.en: Manufacturing footprint changes, order reallocation or line switching reported

action.zh: 取《工艺路线与产能台账》，核对涉及料号的「可变批量 / 换线时间 / 最小运行批次」三列与现行主数据是否一致；由工艺确认变更后首件的检验项，登记差异，不改主数据
action.en: Pull the routing & capacity register and compare changeable lot size / changeover time / minimum run batch against current master data for affected parts. Process engineering confirms first-article inspection items after the change; log differences without editing master data

trigger.zh: 同一料号的产地或产线字段发生一次变更
trigger.en: One change to the origin-site or production-line field for a part

fields.zh: 料号、产地、产线、可变批量、换线时间、最小运行批次、首件检验项
fields.en: Part ID, site, line, changeable lot size, changeover time, min run batch, first-article checks

signal.zh: 报道出现自动化设备故障、系统中断或产线停摆
signal.en: Automation equipment faults, system outages or line stoppages reported

action.zh: 在《设备故障与恢复台账》核对「故障时长 / 恢复时长 / 同因复发次数 / 降级方案」；对复发次数超阈值的设备发起一次根因复核，并把降级方案与在制品处置规则对齐
action.en: Reconcile downtime / recovery time / repeat-failure count / degraded-mode plan in the equipment fault register. Trigger a root-cause review for equipment above the repeat threshold and align the degraded-mode plan with WIP disposition rules

trigger.zh: 同因故障在滚动 4 周内 ≥2 次，或恢复时长超过内部基线上限
trigger.en: Two or more same-cause faults in a rolling 4-week window, or recovery time above the internal baseline ceiling

fields.zh: 设备编号、故障时长、恢复时长、故障码、复发次数、降级方案、在制品处置规则
fields.en: Equipment ID, downtime, recovery time, fault code, repeat count, degraded-mode plan, WIP disposition rule

signal.zh: 报道出现退货回流、召回或质量判定口径变化
signal.en: Return flows, recalls or changes in quality-judgement criteria reported

action.zh: 把《退货质检记录》与《生产批次台账》按批次号对齐，核对「质检项 / 判定阈值 / 复检人 / 批次追溯状态」；批次追溯不到的登记为待核，统一记录口径出处
action.en: Join returns-inspection records to the production batch register by batch ID; reconcile inspection items / thresholds / re-inspector / traceability status. Log untraceable batches as pending and record the source of the judgement standard

trigger.zh: 判定阈值发生一次变更，或同批次复检结论不一致
trigger.en: One change to a judgement threshold, or conflicting re-inspection outcomes on the same batch

fields.zh: 批次号、质检项、判定阈值、初检/复检结论、复检人、追溯状态、口径出处
fields.en: Batch ID, inspection item, threshold, initial/re-inspection result, re-inspector, traceability, standard source

signal.zh: 报道出现双源布局、区域产能迁移或本地化含量要求
signal.en: Dual-sourcing, regional capacity migration or local-content requirements reported

action.zh: 在《料号-供应商-产地映射表》核对每个在供料号的「主源 / 备源 / 产地产能上限 / 认证状态」；对备源为空或认证未覆盖目标产地的料号登记缺口，交采购与制造共同确认优先级
action.en: Reconcile primary source / alternate source / site capacity ceiling / certification status per active part in the part-supplier-site mapping. Log gaps for parts with no alternate or with certification not covering the target site; sourcing and manufacturing jointly set priority

trigger.zh: 产地字段变更一次，或抽检发现备源状态为空
trigger.en: One change to the site field, or an empty alternate-source status found in sampling

fields.zh: 料号、主源、备源、产地、产能上限、认证状态、缺口登记日、优先级
fields.en: Part ID, primary source, alternate, site, capacity ceiling, certification status, gap date, priority

signal.zh: 报道出现 AI / 自动化在产线落地的效果争议或口径不一致
signal.en: Disputed or inconsistently measured AI/automation outcomes on production lines reported

action.zh: 在《自动化收益台账》逐条核对「指标定义 / 统计窗口 / 样本量 / 基线口径 / 数据来源」；由数据治理与工艺各确认一次口径并登记出处；对缺基线或窗口不一致的指标标记为不可比，先统一口径再讨论效果
action.en: Reconcile metric definition / measurement window / sample size / baseline definition / data source in the automation-benefit register. Data governance and process engineering each confirm the definition once and log its source. Mark metrics with no baseline or mismatched windows as non-comparable; align definitions before discussing impact

trigger.zh: 同一指标出现两种口径，或基线口径缺失
trigger.en: Two definitions for the same metric, or a missing baseline definition

fields.zh: 指标名、定义、统计窗口、样本量、基线口径、数据来源、可比性标记
fields.en: Metric, definition, window, sample size, baseline definition, data source, comparability flag

signal.zh: 关键海峡出现袭船、绕行或保险附加条件变化
signal.en: Attacks, rerouting or changing insurance conditions at a critical strait

action.zh: 取《在途运单表》，按「航线代码 / 预计过峡日 / 承运人 / 战争险批注」筛出未来窗口内的在途单，逐单核对 ETA 与改道状态；由订舱向承运人书面确认航路，登记回执，不自行改单
action.en: Filter the in-transit shipment table by lane code / expected strait transit date / carrier / war-risk endorsement. Reconcile ETA and reroute status per shipment; booking obtains written route confirmation from the carrier and logs the reply — do not amend bookings unilaterally

trigger.zh: 同一海峡信号在滚动 4 周内 ≥2 次，或收到保险人条件变更通知
trigger.en: Two or more signals on the same strait in a rolling 4-week window, or an insurer notice of changed conditions

fields.zh: 运单号、航线代码、预计过峡日、承运人、战争险批注、ETA、改道状态、回执编号
fields.en: Shipment ID, lane code, expected strait date, carrier, war-risk endorsement, ETA, reroute status, confirmation ref

signal.zh: 运河日通行量、吃水限制或插队配额发生调整
signal.en: Canal daily transit slots, draft limits or auction quotas change

action.zh: 在《订舱与舱位台账》核对受影响航线的「已订舱位 / 预计通过日 / 是否购得配额 / 备选航线」；对无配额且通过日落在窗口内的订舱登记暴露清单，交由舱位管理逐票确认
action.en: Reconcile booked slots / expected transit date / quota secured / alternate lane in the booking & capacity register. Log exposure for bookings with no quota inside the affected window; capacity management confirms shipment by shipment

trigger.zh: 限制条件发生一次变更，或配额覆盖率低于内部基线
trigger.en: One change to a restriction, or quota coverage falling below the internal baseline

fields.zh: 订舱号、航线、已订舱位、预计通过日、配额状态、备选航线、暴露标记
fields.en: Booking ID, lane, slots booked, expected transit date, quota status, alternate lane, exposure flag

signal.zh: 港口罢工、码头联合行动或堆场饱和被报道
signal.en: Port strikes, coordinated terminal action or yard saturation reported

action.zh: 把《到港预告表》与《仓容日表》按到港日对齐，核对「预计卸货日 / 堆场可用位 / 仓内可用库位 / 提柜时限」；对超出仓容的到港批次登记分流预案，登记而不执行改港
action.en: Join the ETA notice table to the daily capacity table by arrival date; reconcile expected discharge / yard slots / warehouse slots / container pick-up deadline. Log a diversion plan for arrivals exceeding capacity, without executing a port change

trigger.zh: 同一港口信号在滚动 4 周内 ≥2 次，或到港量超过仓容基线上限
trigger.en: Two or more signals on the same port in a rolling 4-week window, or arrivals above the internal capacity ceiling

fields.zh: 到港批次、港口、预计卸货日、堆场可用位、仓内库位、提柜时限、分流预案
fields.en: Arrival batch, port, expected discharge, yard slots, warehouse slots, pick-up deadline, diversion plan

signal.zh: 空运或海运出现「价涨量跌」「运价与货量背离」
signal.en: Air or ocean shows rates rising while volumes fall (price/volume divergence)

action.zh: 在《运费结算明细》按运输方式 + 月度核对「计费重 / 单价 / 附加费项 / 实付金额」，与合同费率表逐项比对；由财务确认偏离项是否为合同内调整，登记差异不直接改计费口径
action.en: Reconcile chargeable weight / unit rate / surcharge lines / amount paid by mode and month in the freight settlement detail, item by item against the contract rate card. Finance confirms whether deviations are contractual; log differences without changing the rating basis

trigger.zh: 背离信号在滚动 4 周内 ≥2 次，或实付单价偏离合同费率表超过内部阈值
trigger.en: Two or more divergence signals in a rolling 4-week window, or paid unit rate deviating from the rate card beyond an internal threshold

fields.zh: 运单号、运输方式、运费承担方、计费重、合同单价、实付单价、附加费项、紧急标识、比价记录、差异原因、确认人
fields.en: Shipment ID, mode, freight payer, chargeable weight, contract rate, paid rate, surcharge lines, expedite flag, quote comparison record, variance reason, approver

signal.zh: 航路回摆、复航造成在途货集中到港，退货窗口随之叠加
signal.en: Lane restoration brings concentrated arrivals, overlapping the returns window

action.zh: 把《预计到货表》与《退货入库预约表》按日到齐，核对「日到货批次 / 退货预约量 / 逆向库位 / 质检工位」；对同一天两类作业撞位的日期登记错峰方案，登记而不自动改预约
action.en: Join the expected-arrival table to the returns-appointment table by day; reconcile arrival batches / returns appointments / reverse-storage slots / inspection stations. Log a staggering plan for days where both operations compete for space, without auto-changing appointments

trigger.zh: 单日到货批次与退货预约量同时超过各自滚动 4 周均值
trigger.en: Both daily arrival batches and returns appointments exceed their own rolling 4-week averages

fields.zh: 日期、到货批次、退货预约量、逆向库位、质检工位、错峰方案、登记人
fields.en: Date, arrival batches, returns appointments, reverse slots, inspection stations, staggering plan, logged by

signal.zh: 末端派送失败、退回件或二次投递占比上升被报道
signal.en: Rising last-mile delivery failures, returned parcels or re-delivery share reported

action.zh: 在《退回件台账》按「退回原因码 / 承运渠道 / 签收状态 / 二次投递次数」分组核对，与客服工单按运单号对齐；对原因码缺失或一单多码的记录登记清洗清单，统一口径后再统计
action.en: Group the returns register by reason code / carrier channel / proof-of-delivery status / re-delivery attempts and join to customer-service tickets by shipment ID. Log cleansing items for missing or duplicate reason codes; align definitions before reporting

trigger.zh: 退回件量超过滚动 4 周均值，或原因码缺失率超过内部阈值
trigger.en: Returned-parcel volume above its rolling 4-week average, or missing reason-code rate above an internal threshold

fields.zh: 运单号、退回原因码、承运渠道、签收状态、二次投递次数、工单号、清洗标记
fields.en: Shipment ID, reason code, carrier channel, POD status, re-delivery attempts, ticket ID, cleansing flag

signal.zh: 报道出现退货质检、机器人分拣或判定规则的口径调整
signal.en: Changes to returns inspection, robotic sorting or judgement-rule definitions reported

action.zh: 把《退货判定规则表》与《质检记录》按规则版本对齐，核对「版本号 / 生效日 / 判定阈值 / 抽检比例」；对跨版本记录标记不可比，先统一口径再评估自动化效果
action.en: Align the returns-judgement rule table with inspection records by rule version; reconcile version / effective date / threshold / sampling rate. Mark cross-version records as non-comparable and harmonise definitions before assessing automation impact

trigger.zh: 规则版本号发生一次变更，或同期存在两个生效版本
trigger.en: One rule-version change, or two versions active in the same period

fields.zh: 规则版本号、生效日、判定阈值、抽检比例、质检记录数、可比性标记
fields.en: Rule version, effective date, threshold, sampling rate, inspection record count, comparability flag

playbookNote.zh: 剧本只触发核查、不代替决策，也不产出补货量或下单量；触发条件为相对量阈值，须由企业按自身基线校准后使用。涉及法规、认证与准入的条目，适用范围与时效以官方最新文本为准。
playbookNote.en: Playbooks trigger verification, not decisions: no replenishment or order quantities are produced. All triggers are relative thresholds that must be calibrated against the company's own baseline. For regulatory, certification and admission items, scope and validity follow the latest official texts.

windowNote.zh: 统计主口径为雷达「期」(issue)，异动基线固定为前 4 期。行动剧本触发条件中的「滚动 4 周 / 连续 2 期」属企业内部模板，默认按自然周理解；期长、起止日与信号计数单位须由企业按自身 ERP 日历校准后方可使用（待校准项）。
windowNote.en: The primary counting unit is a Radar issue; the anomaly baseline is fixed at the previous 4 issues. References to a rolling 4-week window or 2 consecutive periods inside playbooks are internal templates, interpreted as calendar weeks by default; period length, boundaries and signal-count units must be calibrated against the company's own ERP calendar before use (pending calibration).

scope.zh: 统一只用中文词表，沿用「标题 1 词 / 描述 ≥2 个不同词、只取前 600 字」的同一套规则。
scope.en: Chinese-only lexicons, using the same rule: one title hit, or at least 2 distinct terms within the first 600 characters of the description.

recompute.zh: 词典宽度、独占/共现、命中来源与分期覆盖均由信号明细与规则词典在浏览器内逐项复算；等宽裁剪需描述全文，仅在构建期计算，页面不复算该组。
recompute.en: Lexicon width, exclusive/shared counts, hit origin and per-issue coverage are recomputed in-browser from signal details and the lexicon. Equal-width trimming needs full descriptions, so it is build-time only and is not recomputed in the browser.

caveats.zh: 数据源是编辑筛选的新闻，不是企业运营流水。环节「暴露度」反映报道覆盖密度，不等于企业实际风险大小，不可直接用于风险排序或资源分配。
caveats.en: The source is editorially curated news, not operational transactions. Stage exposure measures coverage density, not the size of a company's real risk, and must not be used to rank risks or allocate resources.

caveats.zh: 语料存在主题偏置：航运、运价与中东航路占比高，Deliver 段信号天然密集；Return 段稀疏是语料性质，不代表该环节无风险。
caveats.en: The corpus is topic-biased: shipping, rates and Middle East lanes dominate, so Deliver is naturally dense. Sparse Return coverage is a property of the corpus, not evidence that the stage is risk-free.

caveats.zh: 规则词典是人工编辑口径，不是行业分类标准。一条信号可同时命中多个环节与风险，各分项计数之和大于总条数，不可相加求总或当作占比分母。
caveats.en: The lexicon is an editorial convention, not an industry taxonomy. One signal may hit several stages and risks, so subtotals exceed the signal count and must not be summed or used as a percentage denominator.

caveats.zh: 词典匹配不做语义理解：否定句、反讽、历史回顾与假设句都可能被计入。每条信号的命中词在本页可展开复核，分类器结论需人工抽查。
caveats.en: Lexicon matching has no semantic understanding: negations, irony, historical retrospectives and hypotheticals may all be counted. Hit terms are expandable on every signal, so classifier output needs human spot-checks.

caveats.zh: 异动检测只有 15 期样本、基线仅 4 期；小样本下总体标准差不稳定，z 值只作筛查提示，不是统计显著性检验，也不构成趋势预测。
caveats.en: Anomaly detection has only 15 issues and a 4-issue baseline. Population SD is unstable at this sample size; z-scores are screening hints, not significance tests or trend forecasts.

caveats.zh: 早期若干期存在跨期重复标题（见元数据「重复条数」）。默认保留原始编辑口径不去重；页面提供「排除跨期重复」开关，切换后所有统计随之改变，两种口径不可混用。
caveats.en: Some early issues repeat titles across periods (see the duplicate count in metadata). The default keeps the original editorial basis without deduplication; an Exclude cross-period duplicates switch changes every statistic, so the two bases must not be mixed.

caveats.zh: 加权口径 w = 来源链接数 + 核验标记(0/1)，只是「可追溯性代理」，不是风险概率、影响权重或置信度。默认统计使用不加权条数 n。
caveats.en: The weighted metric w = number of source links + verification flag (0/1) is only a traceability proxy, not a risk probability, impact weight or confidence score. The default basis is the unweighted count n.

caveats.zh: 行动剧本是核查清单，不是决策指令：不出最优库存、不出建议下单量，不承诺任何降本、时效或提升数值；触发条件为相对量模板，须由企业按自身基线校准。
caveats.en: Playbooks are verification checklists, not decision instructions: no optimal inventory, no suggested order quantity, and no promised savings, lead-time or uplift figures. Triggers are relative templates requiring calibration against the company's own baseline.

caveats.zh: 三项业务落地前提（产品内已明示为「待企业校准」，不涉及用户确认）：① 企业 ERP 表名与字段映射须由企业侧定义；② 「滚动 4 周 / 连续 2 期」的日历口径按企业 ERP 日历校准；③ 本产品没有企业实测数据，任何效果类表述均未经业务验证。
caveats.en: Three prerequisites for business rollout (labelled in-product as pending enterprise calibration, not pending user confirmation): (1) ERP table names and field mapping are defined by the company; (2) the calendar convention for rolling 4 weeks / 2 consecutive periods is calibrated to the company's ERP calendar; (3) no enterprise field data exists here, so no impact claim has been validated in practice.

caveats.zh: 数据边界：纯静态快照，不冒充实时；页面零外部请求、无 LLM、无密钥。换用企业真实 ERP / WMS 数据后，规则词典、异动基线与全部断言需整组重写。
caveats.en: Data boundary: a purely static snapshot, never presented as live. The page makes zero external requests, uses no LLM and needs no keys. Swapping in real ERP/WMS data requires rewriting the lexicon, anomaly baseline and every assertion as a set.

caveats.zh: 涉及法规、认证与准入的条目，适用范围与时效以官方最新文本为准，本页不做绝对化合规承诺。
caveats.en: For regulatory, certification and admission items, scope and validity follow the latest official texts. This page makes no absolute compliance promises.

caveats.zh: 规则词典宽度不等：交付 124 词（中文 78 / 英文 46），计划 34、采购 68、生产 32、逆向 17。词表越宽越容易命中，五段命中数不是同口径的环节重要性排序。
caveats.en: Lexicons are uneven: Deliver has 124 terms (78 Chinese / 46 English) versus Plan 34, Source 68, Make 32 and Return 17. Wider lexicons hit more often, so stage counts are not a like-for-like ranking of stage importance.

caveats.zh: 等宽对照（只用中文词表，沿用标题 1 词 / 描述 ≥2 词的规则）：把交付词表裁到与生产相同的 20 词，仍命中 90 条，生产用全量 20 词命中 24 条；每词产出交付 1.25 条、生产 1.47 条。语料的航运 / 运价 / 航路偏置是主因，词典宽度只是放大项。该对照在构建期计算，页面信号明细不含描述全文，不在浏览器内复算。
caveats.en: Equal-width check (Chinese-only lexicons, same one-title-hit / ≥2-description-terms rule): trimming Deliver to Make’s 20 terms still yields 90 hits, while Make’s full 20 terms yield 24. Per-term yield is 1.25 for Deliver and 1.47 for Make. The shipping/rates/lanes bias of the corpus is the main driver; lexicon width only amplifies it. This check is build-time only because signal details omit full descriptions.

caveats.zh: 交付 155 条中 81 条仅命中该段、74 条与其他段共现；五段合计 306 次命中落在 196 条信号上，平均每条 1.56 段。155 是覆盖条数，不是独占分类，不可读作企业风险分布。
caveats.en: Of Deliver’s 155 hits, 81 hit that stage alone and 74 co-occur with another stage; the five stages total 306 hits across 196 signals, 1.56 stages per signal. 155 is a coverage count, not an exclusive classification, and must not be read as an enterprise risk distribution.
